senses.gloss:
√iṣ1 'seek, desire'
present: [6.] icháti icháte etc. V.+ -- [1.] icháti icháte etc. E.+ -- [6.] -iṣa -iṣant E.+ -- [4.] -iṣyati E.+ 
perfect: iyeṣa īṣús īṣe īṣire etc. B.+ 
aorist: [3.] aiṣiṣat -- [5.] aiṣīt aiṣiṣus etc. 
future: [1.] eṣiṣyati etc. eṣiṣyate -- [2.] eṣitā eṣṭā 
verbal: iṣṭá V.+ éṣṭum B.+ éṣṭavaí eṣitum iṣitvā iṣṭvā -íṣya V.+ 
secondary: passive: iṣyate etc. E.+ iṣyati -- desiderative: eṣiṣiṣa- -- causative: eṣayati etc. eṣita ichayāmi 
derivatives: -ichaka E.+ ichā E.+ ichu S.+ íṣ V.B. -iṣa RV. iṣí V. iṣirá V.B. iṣṭí V.B. iṣmín RV. éṣa V.+ eṣá RV. eṣaka E. eṣin AV.+ -eṣyà V.+ éṣaṇa V.+ éṣaṇā B.+ eṣaṇīya C. eṣṭavyà B.+ eṣitavya C. -eṣṭṛ E. -eṣiṣiṣu C. 
Compare the roots 2iṣ and īṣ, eṣ. The present-stems eṣa, iṣa, iṣya only later, unusual, and with certain prepositions.

√iṣ2 'send'
present: [9.] iṣṇā́ti etc. iṣāṇa -- [4.] íṣyati íṣyate etc. V.+ -- [6.] iṣe etc. 
perfect: īṣáthus īṣus īṣiré 
aorist: [5.] praiṣīt E.+ apraiṣīt 
[future: eṣiṣyati eṣitā ]
verbal: iṣitá V.+ iṣitv -íṣya B.+ -éṣam iṣádhyai 
secondary: desiderative: eṣiṣiṣa- -- causative: iṣáyati iṣáyate etc. iṣayádhyai -- -eṣayati iṣayádhyai etc. E.+ eṣyate 
derivatives: iṣáṇi íṣu V.+ -eṣa V.+ -eṣaka E. -eṣya B.+ -eṣaṇa E.+ eṣitavya B.C. -eṣayitṛ E. -eṣitṛ C. 
Doubtless the same with √1iṣ, with causative meaning. In later language, almost only preṣaya. The derivatives hardly occur except with pra.

√īś 'be master'
present: [2.] īṣṭe ī́śate (2s.) etc. ī́kṣe ī́śiṣe ī́śe (3s.) īśite īśidhve V.+ -- [1.] īśate īśata 
perfect: ī́śire? -- īśāṃ cakre 
[aorist: āśiṣṭa ]
future: [1.] īśiṣyati īśiṣyate -- [2.] īśitā 
verbal: īśita 
derivatives: ī́ś īśá B.+ īśā́ AV.+ īśin U.+ īśana U. īśitavya C. īśitṛ U.+ -īśu V.+ īśvará AV.+

√īṣ 'move'
present: [1.] ī́ṣate etc. ī́ṣati etc. -- éṣati etc. 
perfect: īṣé aíyes -- īṣāṃ cakre 
[aorist: aiṣiṣṭa īṣiṣyate īṣitā ]
verbal: -īṣita 
derivatives: īṣā́? eṣá RV. -eṣṭi C. eṣṭṛ́ B.S. 
Doubtless ultimately one with √1, 2iṣ.
